_status: PROPOSED. Nothing in this file is an adopted repository policy. The values are the engineering defaults the P6-CI-6 wiring enforces until an operator decision adopts, changes or waives them; security/gate.py enforces exactly what is written here and adopts nothing on its own.

_authority.vulnerability_threshold: docs/operations/staging-publish-workflow.md section 5 and section 9: the publish-time Trivy scan fails on CRITICAL/HIGH with ignore-unfixed, 'an INFRA-5-set policy pending an explicit repository-wide severity decision' and 'subject to review'. Carried here as the gating severities plus fail_requires_fix_available; every finding the fix-availability filter excludes is listed as EXCLUDED in the gate summary, never hidden.

_authority.misconfiguration_threshold: No source settles an IaC severity threshold. PROPOSED by analogy with the vulnerability threshold: CRITICAL/HIGH fail. No ignore file is tracked; a documented, per-check exception file would be an operator decision.
